scope.rationale: 3 files touched, all within a single product area (projectsManagement). Net change is 83 lines: 5 in the component, 1 in the type, 77 in the test file. No shared components, stores, or routes affected.

technical_depth.rationale: Implementation is a single JSX conditional block (is_active === false) rendering a styled span with a Tailwind class and an aria-label. No state, no hooks, no derived data, no utility functions introduced.

cross_cutting.rationale: Three distinct layers were touched: the domain type (projectBudget.ts), the presentational component, and the test file. All three are within the same feature slice; no cross-slice or cross-page impact.

test_coverage.rationale: Five targeted test cases cover the meaningful states: is_active=false shows indicator, is_active=true hides it, is_active=undefined (omitted) hides it, is_active=null hides it, and manage mode shows it. Edge cases for null and undefined were explicitly handled, matching the strict-equality guard in the implementation.

risk.rationale: Purely additive change. The new type field is optional (backward-compatible with existing API payloads that omit it). The component guard uses strict equality (=== false) so undefined/null do not trigger the indicator. No existing rendering paths were altered.

dependencies.rationale: No new npm dependencies, no new internal imports, no new utility modules. Uses only existing Tailwind color token (text-failed-secondary) already present in the theme.

documentation.rationale: No inline comments, no JSDoc, no guide updates. An aria-label was added to the indicator span, which is minimal accessibility annotation rather than documentation.

reversibility.rationale: Trivially reversible: remove 5 lines from the component, 1 line from the type, and the test suite. No schema migrations, no stored state, no API contract changes. The optional type field leaves nothing behind if dropped.

domain_complexity.rationale: Requires only the knowledge that a ProjectBudget can be inactive and that the flag is a boolean. No budget calculation logic, no financial rules, no multi-state workflow understanding needed.

summary: Minimal additive change: one optional boolean field added to a type, a five-line conditional indicator injected into an existing card component, and five edge-case tests. No logic, state, or cross-cutting concerns were modified.
